§3 Leave Policy v2 · effective 01 Apr 2026

Staff receive 12 casual/regular leave days and 10 earned leave days per academic year. Leave is held per employment and never pooled across entities. A leave day debits the ledger only when it falls on a working day for staff; holidays never debit.

Punch-in beyond the 10-minute grace period is marked late; repeated lateness converts to leave under the tardiness-credit rule.
